name: @pacsarcade/presence
description: Ephemeral multiplayer presence for puck-studio — a transport-agnostic presence client (heartbeat, debounced state, TTL peer table, bye) with a nip44-encrypted nostr transport (kind 25050 rooms over SimplePool) and React bindings that ride Puck's own store: a bridge that publishes selection + breakpoint, peer chips, and CSS-injection-hardened selection halos.
